label: Lab 13
title: Does an agent company get better, measured blind?
question: When we fix our agents' recipes and tools, do their answers get better on work the fixes were not made on?
how: The same work items, answered before and after the fixes, each answer judged by a separate AI reviewer that was not told which side wrote it. Two of the three sets were held out from the fixing.
status: Judged by an AI, not a person · cited by hash
